name: 流动/速动/资产负债率分析

map.由流动资产、存货、预付费用、流动负债与资产负债数据，计算流动比率、速动比率、现金: From current assets, inventory, prepaid expenses, current liabilities and asset-liability data, compute current ratio, quick ratio, cash ratio, working capital, debt-to-asset ratio, equity ratio and equity multiplier, and give reference-range judgments.
map.流动比率 = 流动资产 ÷ 流动负债 速动比率 = (流动资产 − 存货 −: Current ratio = current assets / current liabilities; quick ratio = (current assets - inventory - prepaid expenses) / current liabilities; cash ratio = cash and equivalents / current liabilities; working capital = current assets - current liabilities; debt-to-asset ratio = total liabilities / total assets; equity ratio = total liabilities / owners' equity; equity multiplier = total assets / owners' equity.
map.流动比率衡量短期偿债能力，速动比率把变现能力较弱的存货与预付费用剔除，更严格地反: The current ratio measures short-term solvency; the quick ratio strips out the less-liquid inventory and prepaid expenses for a stricter view of 'how much can be repaid anytime'; the cash ratio looks only at cash and equivalents, the most conservative of the three lines of defense. The debt-to-asset ratio, equity ratio and equity multiplier reflect long-term solvency and leverage from a capital-structure view, and are mathematically reconcilable (equity multiplier = 1 / (1 - debt-to-asset ratio)). Reference ranges vary greatly by industry (retail and real estate with heavy advance receipts often have a current ratio below 1); the page's bands are general rules of thumb and should be compared with industry peers.

map.流动资产 500,000、存货 180,000、预付费用 20,000、现金 8: Current assets 500,000, inventory 180,000, prepaid 20,000, cash 80,000, current liabilities 300,000, total liabilities 700,000, total assets 1,200,000 -> current ratio 1.67 (average), quick ratio 1.00 (good), cash ratio 0.27 (good), debt-to-asset 58.33% (moderate), equity ratio 1.40, equity multiplier 2.40; working capital = 500,000 - 300,000 = 200,000 yuan, owners' equity = 1,200,000 - 700,000 = 500,000 yuan, reconciliation 1 / (1 - 0.5833) = 2.40 consistent. The page also hints 'current ratio acceptable but quick ratio low', pointing to a high inventory share.
map.流动比率一定要大于 2 吗？: Must the current ratio be above 2?
map.不必。2 是制造业的传统经验值；预收占款多的零售与地产、现金结算快的餐饮，流动比: Not necessarily. 2 is a traditional rule of thumb for manufacturing; retail and real estate with heavy advance receipts, and catering with fast cash settlement, often have a current ratio below 1. Judge by comparing with industry peers and your own historical range, and watch whether the quick and cash ratios deteriorate together.
map.速动比率里的存货该全剔除吗？: Should inventory be fully excluded from the quick ratio?
map.本工具按 (流动资产 − 存货 − 预付费用) ÷ 流动负债 计算，即把变现能力: This tool computes (current assets - inventory - prepaid expenses) / current liabilities, excluding both less-liquid items. If inventory turns over very fast (e.g. fast-moving consumer goods), a partial-inventory basis may be kept; the key is consistency across periods for the same firm and across firms in the same industry.
map.所有者权益为负时为什么有的指标不显示？: Why are some indicators hidden when owners' equity is negative?
map.权益为负（资不抵债）时，产权比率与权益乘数的分母为负，数值失去解释意义，页面会显: When equity is negative (insolvent), the denominators of the equity ratio and equity multiplier are negative and the figures lose meaning; the page shows 'cannot compute' with a hint. The debt-to-asset ratio can still be computed (will exceed 100%) and more directly reflects the degree of insolvency.
map.参考区间是通用经验值：零售、地产等预收占款较多的行业流动比率常低于 1 仍属正常: Reference ranges are general rules of thumb: industries with heavy advance receipts such as retail and real estate often have a current ratio below 1 and it is still normal; always compare with industry peers.
map.速动比率已剔除存货与预付费用，若企业还有一年内到期的非流动资产、待摊费用等，应按: The quick ratio already excludes inventory and prepaid expenses; if the firm also has non-current assets due within a year, deferred expenses, etc., adjust further per its own basis.
map.流动负债必须大于 0，否则三个短期比率均无意义；所有者权益为负时不计算产权比率与: Current liabilities must be greater than 0, otherwise the three short-term ratios are meaningless; when owners' equity is negative the equity ratio and equity multiplier are not computed.
map.资产负债率与权益乘数存在勾稽关系（权益乘数 = 1 ÷ (1 − 资产负债率)）: The debt-to-asset ratio and equity multiplier have a reconciliation relation (equity multiplier = 1 / (1 - debt-to-asset ratio)); the page performs a consistency check.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入数据不会上传到服务器；结果仅供参考，不作为授信或审计依据。: This tool runs entirely in the browser; input data is not uploaded to any server; results are for reference only and not as a basis for credit or audit.
